{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Calculate conversion rate: fraction of loyal customers who converted
converted_count = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
total_loyal = len(loyal_df)
conversion_rate = converted_count / total_loyal

print(f"Number of loyal customers: {total_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal customers: {converted_count}")
print(f"Conversion rate among loyal customers: {conversion_rate}")"}
